sampling: All eligible flows from the pilot extraction, with the original capture holdout fixed.
attribution: Draper-Gil et al., Characterization of Encrypted and VPN Traffic Using Time-Related Features, ICISSP 2016
unit: first up to 32 captured IPv4 TCP/UDP packets per bidirectional five-tuple with 60s idle timeout per file; minimum 20 packets, bidirectional within prefix; magnitude <=1600; exclude IP fragmentation; first endpoint positive
stop: single experiment, no tuning on held-out outcomes
readout: Fit the six original frozen D4 encoders with fixed standardized logistic readouts on all 2656 clean ISCX training flows. RF and SVM reported separately.
checkpoint: Stage A SmolLM2-135M LoRA distilled on D4
uncertainty: capture-group paired bootstrap on mean classifier accuracy, 2000 draws
masks: uniform whole packet 10%,30%,50% with same rows and positions for both imputers
split: Reuse pilot held-out capture groups. Exclude complete sequence hashes in expanded ISCX train and D4 student train/validation. Do not select checkpoints or change prompts on these outcomes.
primary: SmolLM2-135M LoRA Stage A versus local TFI. Six-classifier mean accuracy, macro-F1 over supported labels, and missing-packet magnitude MAE by loss rate.
comparison: 662 held-out flows including 600 outside the pilot test set but from the same 19 capture groups. This measures sample expansion within the same captures.
cache: Reuse prior predictions only for equal mask inputs and identical student checkpoint. For teachers require exact request hashes.
